content:
incident-bot: PAGER — Severity 2: Multiple checks failing for CDN POP group eu-west-1 (Dublin). 
- >20% packet loss to edge node set: euw-dub-01/02
- BGP route flaps observed to upstream AS 64512
- Alerts: edge-conn-loss, http-5xx-spike
See: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/d/edge-pop/eu-west-1?orgId=1

sam: I'm oncall, acknowledged. paging network/edge. starting triage.

sam: quick checks — curl to a healthy host in same region times out, traceroute shows drop at hop 6 (ISP transit).
> traceroute euw-dub-01.redwood.edge
> 1  gw1 (10.0.0.1)  1.2 ms
> 2  ...
> 6  isp-transit (203.0.113.45)  * * *

aya: seeing BGP withdraws for prefixes announced by euw-dub from our provider. spikes align w/packet loss windows. likely upstream/peering flap, not our edge hw. I'm on the provider channel.

sam: mitigation plan: 1) enable POP fallback to eu-central-1 for traffic destined to eu-west-1 2) drain new persistent connections on affected POPs 3) update status page and customers. Executing now.

sam: runbook commands:
```
# enable gradual fallback for 30m and drain connections
redwoodctl routing set-pop-fallback --pop eu-west-1 --fallback eu-central-1 --mode gradual --drain 30m
# verify active routing changes
redwoodctl routing show --pop eu-west-1
```

leo: I applied the fallback (redwoodctl returned 200). traffic shift: 60% -> eu-central-1 within 5m, CPU on eu-central up ~12% but within headroom. metrics: error-rate on eu-west-1 dropping, overall 5xxs down 70%. :thumbsup:

marta: CS triage: customer-facing alerts queued. early impact estimate: ~12 customers saw increased latencies; 5 had brief 5xx spikes, largest affected account Acme Retail (shopping-checkout errors). I've notified their SE and opened support ticket #SE-8921.

aya: provider (CloudNet) responded: "Investigating flapping transit to eu-west-1; potential maintenance incident on ISP fabric. Ticket CN-33421 opened." They've asked for traceroutes and BGP dumps. Uploading logs.

sam: posted initial incident note to status.redwood.ai (status: degraded) and added link to this thread. Notifying legal/comms for customers with SLOs impacted.

ops-bot: Scheduled follow-up reminder in 15m. Pagerduty escalation window extended to 45m.

sam: handoff plan — I will hand over to aya for network remediation and provider follow-ups at HH:MM (30m from now). I'll remain reachable for rollback. Aya, please own until confirmed fix + postmortem.

aya: taking over. current actions: 1) continue liaising with CloudNet for BGP stabilization 2) validate whether community tagging/prepend helps 3) prepare BGP patch to announce alternate path if provider confirms.

cdndev: note: caching TTLs for affected POPs reduced earlier — will hold on cache purges until rollback. Avoid mass cache invalidations during routing churn.

leo: metrics now show packet loss down to ~2% at euw-dub after provider applied fixes on their edge; HTTP 5xxs normalized to baseline. Traffic gradually moved back (we're keeping fallback until stable for 15m).

marta: update to customers: posted targeted messages to affected accounts (incl. Acme Retail). No data loss reported; functional degradation only.

aya: CloudNet confirms peering fabric incident resolved on their end; they will monitor for 1 hour. They recommend we keep fallback for 15-30m and then revert.

sam: planned rollback: in 20m will remove fallback and re-route traffic back to eu-west-1 if no recurrence. command: `redwoodctl routing unset-pop-fallback --pop eu-west-1`

ops-bot: Reminder: 10m until planned rollback.

leo: rollback executed, routing normal. running health checks... all green.

sam: incident status: resolved — packet loss returned to baseline, HTTP errors resolved. created incident page and assigned postmortem to aya + leo. Postmortem owner: aya. ETA draft in 48h.

marta: CS wrap: notified all impacted customers, offered post-incident call with Acme Retail; they accepted.

incident-bot: auto-log: incident_kind: cdn-pop-connectivity; duration: 00:52:11; severity: 2; peak_customers_impacted: 12; tickets: CN-33421, SE-8921. Follow-up tasks: postmortem, update runbook for POP fallback checklist, adjust monitoring thresholds to catch BGP withdraws sooner.

sam: thanks all — great quick response. handoff complete. :heart:
